name: Annette Rodriguez
office: City of Santa Fe Springs, Member of the City Council

items.text: Annette Rodriguez is a Santa Fe Springs City Council member and was selected as mayor in September 2026. She has served on the Safe Neighborhood Team, the Family and Human Services Committee, and as president of the Santa Fe Springs Women's Club. She is an executive board member of the Los Angeles Centers for Alcohol and Drug Abuse. In August 2026, when Rodriguez was mayor pro tem, the council enacted a 45-day moratorium on new blood banks and plasma centers. In 2026, the city temporarily revoked the Metropolitan Little League's field access over subleasing accusations. A witness told the Los Angeles Times that Rodriguez urged parents to vote the league's board out. The city later reinstated the league's access.
